title: Shared spaces as of late
content: Anyone notice an increase of people giving accounts of mall world type places in the past month? A few common themes I keep coming across are the inside of the mall with the escalators, outside in the parking lot where there is a chain link fence with some type of construction happening, the fancy hotel with the crazy hallway carpet, the run down apartments, and the houses on stilts. In the past I don’t think I’ve been too concerned with the other people I come across when I’m in MallWorld but lately I’ve noticed a few things: It reminds me of Disney in that the people are all speaking different languages. BUT I can understand them somehow. Also noticed some people now walking through all of the spaces with like yellow vests on. Lastly, there are people playing cards in the stilt houses now.
